description: Diaspora opportunities and deadlines. Open grants, RFPs, fellowships and programs relevant to diaspora businesses, each verified at its primary source before listing, with deadlines. Filter by country, topic tag, or deadlines closing within N days. $0.1 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

closing_within_days.description: only items with a deadline within this many days (optional)

country.description: country tag on the item, e.g. US, KE (optional)
